description_expanded: Hey Jude - Pet-Friendly Luxury Vacation Rental with Private Pool and Beach Views Favorite Features: - Private Pool (Heat Available) - Gulf View - Pets Allowed - Bunk Rooms - Golf Cart  More about Hey Jude: Welcome to Hey Jude, a luxurious retreat in the heart of Gulf Place, thoughtfully designed for unforgettable gatherings with family and friends. This stunning home comfortably sleeps up to 26 guests with 7 king bedrooms and 3 spacious bunkrooms, offering everyone their own slice of comfort and privacy. The modern interior is elevated with a touch of glam—from sleek finishes and stylish furnishings to multiple living rooms that provide the perfect balance of relaxation and connection. The kitchen is a true standout, fully equipped with top-of-the-line professional appliances that make cooking for a crowd a joy. Just a two-minute stroll from both the beach and the vibrant energy of Gulf Place—with boutique shopping, live music, and dining favorites like Shunk Gulley—you’ll find everything you need within easy reach. Step outside and discover your own lush, private oasis. The fenced backyard is a dream for both people and pets, featuring green grass, tropical landscaping, and plenty of room to relax or play. The private pool—with optional heat and a built-in table for poolside drinks or card games—invites endless hours of sun-soaked fun. Nearby, the fully-equipped outdoor kitchen makes alfresco dining a breeze. Grill up a feast with the built-in grill, griddle, warming drawer, mini fridge, and gas burner perfect for low country boils. Extras like a golf cart, four bikes, and two sets of backpack beach chairs make it easy to explore all that 30A has to offer. Whether you're gathering for a celebration, a reunion, or simply a coastal escape, Hey Jude offers a seamless blend of luxury, comfort, and laid-back charm. All you need is love… and a stay at Hey Jude! Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: 2 Twin over Twin Bunks. Bedroom 2: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 3: King Bed & Shared Bathroom with Shower. SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 4: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 5: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower.  Bedroom 6: 2 Twin over Twin Bunks. THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 7: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 8: King Bed with Shared Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 9: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. Bedroom 10: 2 Twin over Twin Bunks.
